text:
Hi Daniel,

Quick update on the billing migration. The new invoices went out on Monday and the numbers match the old system to the cent. We still have two customers on the legacy plan, and I will move them over this week once their contracts renew.

Let me know if you see anything odd on your side. Happy to walk through it on a call if that is easier.

Best,
Priya

Hi Maria,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the contract. Legal signed off this morning, so we can start on the first of next month as planned. I have shared the onboarding checklist with your team and added the two dates we talked about.

Let me know if you see anything odd in the checklist. I will keep you posted as the start date gets closer.

Best,
Priya

Hi team,

Quick update on the release. The build is green and the staging tests passed overnight, so we are on track for Thursday. The only open item is the export bug that Sam found, and he expects a fix by Wednesday afternoon.

Let me know if you see anything odd in staging before then. I will keep you posted if the date moves.

Best,
Priya

Hi Daniel,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the pricing sheet. I went through it this morning and the numbers match what we agreed last week. The only change I would make is to the support tier, which should say twelve hours rather than twenty-four.

Happy to walk through it on a call if that is easier. Let me know if you see anything odd in the rest of it.

Best,
Priya

Hi Maria,

Quick update on the onboarding. Your team has access to the dashboard now, and the first data import finished without errors. The training session is booked for Tuesday at ten, and I have sent the invite to everyone on your list.

Let me know if you see anything odd in the imported data. I will keep you posted on the second import.

Best,
Priya
